mapper.select: select (select count(*) from sys_user where del_flag = '0') as "userCount", (select count(*) from sm_product where del_flag = '0') as "productCount", (select count(*) from sm_product where del_flag = '0' and status = 'ON_SALE') as "onSaleCount", (select count(*) from sm_order where del_flag = '0') as "orderCount", (select count(*) from sm_order where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= current_date) as "todayOrderCount", (select count(*) from sm_inspection_report where del_flag = '0') as "reportCount"

select to_char(d.day, 'MM-DD') as day, count(o.id) as cnt from generate_series(current_date - interval '6 day', current_date, interval '1 day') as d(day) left join sm_order o on o.create_time >= d.day and o.create_time < d.day + interval '1 day' group by d.day order by d.day
select status as name, count(*) as value from sm_order where del_flag = '0' group by status order by value desc

select c.name as name, count(p.id) as value from sm_category c left join sm_product p on p.category_id = c.id and p.del_flag = '0' where c.level = 1 group by c.id, c.name order by value desc limit #{limit}
